name: diagnostic-logging
description: DIAGNOSTIC BUILD, NOT FOR DRIVING, AND NOT USEFUL ON ITS OWN - points the logging sink at 0x010346d0 (dummyLogMsg, shipped as `li r3,0 ; blr`) at `Log_msg`, so the ~6700 call sites that call the sink directly reach the real logger. On its own it emits nothing, because `Log_msg` returns at the trace-mask gate. With `diagnostic-logmask` it is worse: 0x010346d0 is also the sink `Log_msg` itself calls, so the logger and the sink call each other on every log call in the firmware. For a diagnostic build use `diagnostic-logmask` + `diagnostic-logsink` (builds/diagnostic-logging.json). See docs/PATCHES.md. NAV only.
summary: redirects the logging stub to the real logger

status.label: Not for driving
status.note: diagnostic build; needs the mask patch too

patches.why: dummyLogMsg (li r3,0 ; blr) -> b Log_msg @ 0x02742558. Log_msg takes r3=level, r4=format and the caller has already set those, so the branch passes them straight through and every gated log site in the image becomes live.
